note: Fourth held-out set: 30 messages (15 scam, 15 benign) written by a third party (Gemini), covering different scam types than all earlier sets. It was not seen while the round 1 and round 2 rules were written; first contact, before round 3: 13.3% detection (2/15), 0% strong, 6.7% false alarms (1/15). It is now seen after round 3 (used for tuning): its misses and false alarm guided the credential-request fix and the unfamiliar-link-pressure signal, so later numbers are optimistic (heldout5 is the next fully unseen set). English only. Synthetic, so the numbers are not a guarantee of real-world accuracy. Messages use the same fields as heldout3.json: { id, label, category, text }.
